heading: INT. SALVAGE TUG "HALCYON" - COMMAND DECK - SHIP TIME 0412

units.text: INT. SALVAGE TUG "HALCYON" - COMMAND DECK - SHIP TIME 0412
Dim blue.
Instrument glow.
Frost on the edge of a viewport that shows nothing but black and a distant, tumbling hull.
COMMANDER ISSA (40s, grey jumpsuit, scar through one eyebrow) sits in the captain's chair, eyes on a scrolling console.
ROOK (30s, engineer, pushed-up sleeves, grease on her cheek) kneels under an open panel, wiring.
ENSIGN TARQUIN (20s, pressed uniform, nervous hands) stands at the comms station with a headset.
Status on the derelict.
units.name: ISSA

units.text: Thermal reading's ambient, Commander. No heat signature.
units.name: TARQUIN

units.text: Life signs?
units.name: ISSA

units.text: None.
units.name: TARQUIN

units.text: Which means there's nothing to find, so why are we still here?
units.name: ROOK

units.text: Because it's salvage, Rook. Salvage pays.
units.name: ISSA

units.text: It pays if the thing doesn't kill us.
units.name: ROOK

units.text: Does anyone else feel that temperature drop?
units.name: TARQUIN

units.text: Nobody answers.
Issa taps the console.
A pulse of green runs through the hull.
Rook, how long until we're docked?
units.name: ISSA

units.text: Ninety minutes if I finish the seal.
units.name: ROOK

units.text: Do it in sixty.
units.name: ISSA

units.text: Sure. And I'll grow another arm.
units.name: ROOK

units.text: She slides out, seals the panel, and wipes her hands.
The deck lights flicker.
A tone chimes.
Commander, we have an incoming hail. From the derelict.
units.name: TARQUIN

units.text: Impossible.
units.name: ISSA

units.text: Audio only.
units.name: TARQUIN

units.text: Put it up.
units.name: ISSA

units.text: A hiss of static.
Then a thin voice, a whisper through a thousand miles of vacuum.
...please... anyone... the hull is breached... we are still aboard...
units.name: JONAH

units.text: It's repeating. Same thirty seconds. Loop.
units.name: TARQUIN

units.text: Who's aboard? The manifest said the crew was evacuated.
units.name: ROOK

units.text: The manifest said a lot of things.
units.name: ISSA

units.text: He stands.
Straightens his jumpsuit.
Looks at each of them in turn.
Rook, suit up. Tarquin, keep the channel open. I'm going over.
units.name: ISSA

units.text: Alone, Commander?
units.name: TARQUIN

units.text: Nobody else is qualified to be wrong.
units.name: ISSA

units.text: Sir, with respect, that's the stupidest thing I've ever heard.
units.name: ROOK

units.text: It's also the plan.
units.name: ISSA

units.text: Rook sighs, grabs a helmet.
Tarquin tightens his headset.
At the airlock, the inner door cycles open with a soft pneumatic breath.
A figure stands inside, in a salvage suit that doesn't fit the Halcyon's fleet.
JONAH (40s, a ragged beard behind a cracked faceplate, one glove missing) holds a flare gun in his remaining hand.
Don't. Don't touch the console.
units.name: JONAH

units.text: Who are you?
units.name: ISSA

units.text: Jonah Reyes. Navigator, Mercator. I've been on that hull for fourteen months.
units.name: JONAH

units.text: That's impossible.
units.name: TARQUIN

units.text: It's the only thing I've been telling myself.
units.name: JONAH

units.text: Fourteen months.
units.name: ROOK

units.text: Jonah steps forward, the flare gun trembling.
Commander. Listen to me. That loop isn't mine. I stopped sending it a year ago. Something else is using my voice.
units.name: JONAH

units.text: Issa's hand finds the emergency stud on his chair arm.
The lights go red.
A claxon begins.
Everyone to stations. Rook, seal the airlock. Tarquin, sever the hull link.
units.name: ISSA

units.text: Sever?
units.name: TARQUIN

units.text: Do it now!
units.name: ISSA

units.text: Tarquin slams the break lever.
The viewport flares.
On the derelict, a long, slow light switches on, bright as a second sun, and turns toward the Halcyon.
Too late.
units.name: JONAH

units.text: The whole ship shudders.
The flare gun drops from Jonah's hand and bounces on the deck, spinning, lighting every face in turn.
